findings: THE OFFER GIVEN AS A RULE. 'Researchers should schedule a research appointment in advance with Reference Archivist Kristen Chinery.' The library's About page, saved the same day: 'The collections housed in the Reuther Library are freely open to the public. Appointments are not required' and 'To schedule a research appointment, contact Kristen Chinery'. The composition turns the library's offer into a rule for every researcher.

THE CUSTODIAN OF THE UNIONS' OWN RECORDS. 'Serves as the official repository for major labor unions and organizations, including the United Automobile Workers (UAW)'. The building was 'constructed with funds given to Wayne State University by the United Automobile, Aerospace, and Agricultural Implement Workers of America' (the library's page); the composition gives the years of the building and wing without the gift. The census asks of such an archive whether it keeps the records of the oppositions inside the unions it holds; neither the composition nor the census's saved pages say. The Wikipedia card's 'personal papers from labor activists and union leaders' becomes, in the composition, papers 'of labor leaders'.
